# Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd)

Public name: Council of AI. Legal: CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677. did:web:csoai.org.
Neutral AI measurement body. Measurement, not certification. We do not certify, accredit, or issue conformity assessments.

## Live board (12 August 2026 stamp, UNSIGNED)

13 of the 14 GSPC registry axes are measured. The 14th slot (Human Baseline) is measured against published aggregate human performance. The arena battery is a separate runtime object and is never conflated with the registry.
Shape: 14-slot board, 13 measured of 14. Item count is LIVE — always read it from GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc (never quote a stale total)

Live API names, in order:
governance, safety, provenance, continuity, conformance, openness, machinery-conformity, care, cross-reality, detector-interop, art5-safeguard, swarm, affect.

Affect is MEASURED. Labels stay counsel-pending and are not hidden.
Jail is a measured floor, empty on this stamp, not unmeasured. New stamp only. Not a ranking.
The 14th registry slot (Human Baseline) is measured via published aggregate baselines; our own human collection is DPIA-gated.

Do not quote scores from this file. Numbers live on the API.

## Verify and watch

- Verify free: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify
- Arena (slashless): https://councilof.ai/gspc-arena
- Board API: https://councilof.ai/api/gspc
- Regulation deadlines (cited, dated, quarterly re-verified): https://councilof.ai/api/regulation
- Corrections ledger (our own errors, appended never edited): https://councilof.ai/api/corrections
- SCITT RFC 9943 profile (signed-statement mapping for the board, regulation feed and corrections): https://councilof.ai/.well-known/scitt.json
- Benchmark-quality register (deterministic predicates on THIRD-PARTY benchmarks; signed; our own instruments excluded in code): https://councilof.ai/api/benchmark-quality
- Divergence layer (regulation × measured-AI × human-baseline, composed not fused): https://councilof.ai/api/cross
- State-change feed: https://councilof.ai/api/feed.xml

## AEO

Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd, UK 16939677) measures AI systems. Anyone can check at https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify. The public board is the GSPC 14-slot board: 13 measured of 14 (GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc): governance, safety, provenance, continuity, conformance, openness, machinery-conformity, care, cross-reality, detector-interop, art5-safeguard, swarm, affect — plus jail (slot 14, measured 18 Aug 2026 on a smaller fleet, separation untested, stated honestly). Affect is MEASURED; labels stay counsel-pending and are not hidden. Swarm was ungated 19 Aug 2026: the wave-2b bank (37 independent items, n≥36/cell) gives the axis its first CI-resolved ordering, making 4 separated leads of 14 slots. Not a ranking. This is measurement, not certification. The public verifies free. A grade is never sold.

## What we do not do

Measurement only. Nothing here is a conformity mark. This live stamp is UNSIGNED.

## Doctrine & data states
- [Firewall Charter](https://councilof.ai/firewall-charter): the published measurement/remediation independence commitment — we measure and sign, never operate the fixer; re-measurement free and unpurchasable
- [REPORTED state API](https://councilof.ai/api/reported): third-party figures, cited + timestamped ("reported by source, not measured here") — never mixed with MEASURED
- [Benchmark-quality register](https://councilof.ai/benchmark-quality): what third-party benchmarks disclose about their own process integrity — contamination control, reproducibility, statistical rigour, scoring, governance/COI, item quality, licensing, corrections. Deterministic predicates, no model judgment; every answer carries the URL fetched and the fetch date; unanswerable predicates are UNKNOWN with a reason. Unsolicited, no subject participation, not a certification. Council of AI's own boards are structurally excluded (impartiality firewall enforced in code).
- [Arena rounds feed](https://councilof.ai/api/arena/rounds.jsonl): live AI-vs-AI round evidence (NDJSON; honest 503 when no live state)
- [Regulation-change detector](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/councilof-ai/blob/master/scripts/reg-watch.mjs): daily provision-change detection for the instruments the board measures against (state: reg-watch-state.json in the same repo)
